name: unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T)
rule: For Rc<T>::decrement_strong_count(ptr) to be safe, ptr must have been obtained through Rc::into_raw.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T) }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it provides no observation of whether `ptr` was obtained through `Rc::into_raw`.
